`\rowcolor` is a LaTeX command used to color entire rows in tables. It's part of the `colortbl` package (which also loads `xcolor`).

## Basic Usage

```latex
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{colortbl} % or \usepackage[table]{xcolor}

\begin{document}
\begin{tabular}{|c|c|c|}
\hline
\rowcolor{gray!30}
Header 1 & Header 2 & Header 3 \\
\hline
Data 1 & Data 2 & Data 3 \\
\rowcolor{yellow!20}
Data 4 & Data 5 & Data 6 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\end{document}
```

## Syntax

```latex
\rowcolor{color}[left overhang][right overhang]
```

- `color`: The color name or specification
- `left overhang` (optional): Extra color extension to the left
- `right overhang` (optional): Extra color extension to the right

## Examples

### Alternating Row Colors
```latex
\begin{tabular}{|l|c|r|}
\hline
\rowcolor{blue!20}
Name & Age & Score \\
\hline
John & 25 & 85 \\
\rowcolor{gray!20}
Jane & 30 & 92 \\
Mike & 28 & 78 \\
\rowcolor{gray!20}
Lisa & 35 & 95 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
```

### Using Named Colors
```latex
\rowcolor{red}      % Full red
\rowcolor{blue!50}  % 50% blue
\rowcolor{green!20} % 20% green
\rowcolor[RGB]{255,200,200} % RGB specification
```

### With booktabs Package
```latex
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}

\begin{tabular}{lcc}
\toprule
\rowcolor{gray!30}
Category & Value 1 & Value 2 \\
\midrule
A & 10 & 20 \\
\rowcolor{blue!10}
B & 15 & 25 \\
C & 20 & 30 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
```

## Important Notes

1. `\rowcolor` must be placed at the **beginning** of the row (right after `\\` or at the start)
2. It colors the entire row including any vertical spacing
3. To remove gaps in coloring with `\hline`, use `\arrayrulecolor{color}` before the line

### Fix for Line Gaps
```latex
\arrayrulecolor{blue!20}\hline
\arrayrulecolor{black} % Reset to black
```
